viewer.title: Ilebhu Egxilile
viewer.atlasSubtitle: Hlola imodeli ephilayo yezinhlelo ezingu-{{count}} zomzimba. Khetha uhlelo, hlukanisa izingxenye zalo bese ukhetha isakhiwo ukuze uhlole indima yaso.
viewer.atlasGuidedBy: Uqondiswa nguDkt. Alistair Vance · Ilebhu yebhayoloji ye-XR, isitezi 4 ·
viewer.noMatches: Ayikho imiphumela. Zama elinye lamagama aphakanyisiwe.
viewer.tapHint: Thinta ingxenye kumodeli ukuze uhlole indima yayo. Hudula ukuze ujikeleze ngaphandle kokukhetha.
viewer.webglError: Lesi siphequluli asikwazanga ukuqala isibukeli se-3D. Nika amandla i-WebGL bese ulayisha kabusha.

pricing.title: Ikhampasi eyodwa, zonke izabelomali
pricing.subtitle: Qala mahhala. Nyukela uma udinga ukufundiswa kwe-AI okwengeziwe, izitifiketi noma izihlalo. Okwaminyaka konke kongela izinyanga ezimbili.
pricing.trialBody: Amacebo akhokhelwayo afaka izinsuku ezingu-14 zokuzama (izinsuku ezingu-30 ezikoleni). Khansela noma nini.
pricing.payBody: Amakhadi nge-Stripe (USD) ne-PayFast (ZAR) — kufaka i-Instant EFT, i-SnapScan ne-mobicred lapho kutholakala khona.
pricing.cancelBody: Khansela ekupheleni kwesikhathi kuphothali yakho. Ugcina ukufinyelela kuze kuphele — akukho ukuzibophezela.

anatomy.label: I-Atlasi Yomuntu
anatomy.description: Hlola izinhlelo zomuntu njengemodeli esebenzisanayo. Hlukanisa izakhiwo ubone ukuthi zisebenzisana kanjani.

plants.label: Izinhlelo Zezitshalo
plants.description: Landela ukuthi izimpande, izicubu zemithambo namahlamvu kuhambisa kanjani amanzi futhi kuthwebule amandla.

engineering.label: Izinhlelo Zamabhuloho
engineering.description: Hlakaza ibhuloho lamathrusi ubone ukuthi amandla ahamba kanjani.

vehicle.label: Izinhlelo Zemoto Kagesi
vehicle.description: Hlakaza i-SUV kagesi: ukugcinwa kwamandla, amamotho, i-chassis nomzimba.

earth.label: Izinhlelo Zomhlaba
earth.description: Hlola iplanethi enezingqimba nezinhlelo ezenza ubuso bayo nomkhathi.

elementary.label: Isisekelo
elementary.focus: Ukumangala nokuqamba: yini, ibukeka kanjani, yenzani?

middle.label: Isikole esiphakathi
middle.focus: Izindlela zokusebenza: isebenza kanjani, ungayihlola kanjani?

high.label: Isikole samabanga aphezulu
high.focus: Imithetho nobufakazi: kungani kufanele kuziphathe kanje, sazi kanjani?

university.label: Inyuvesi
university.focus: Ukuvamile: ngaphansi kwaziphi izimo lokhu kusebenza, kuphi lapho kwephuka?

professional.label: Ochwepheshe
professional.focus: Ukusetyenziswa: ngiyisebenzisa, ngiyiqinisekisa noma ngiyifundisa kanjani ngokuqinisekile?
